answer: Reverse-escrow work auction. Each new identity must pre-fund a velvet deposit that is released only after completing a paid task whose reward is split across all bidders; a clone lowers its own expected payout below the deposit while the nebula of honest bidders absorbs the surplus. The attacker pays the full deposit per clone, recovered only by outcompeting every rival, so marginal clones are strictly negative-EV. Honest entry stays cheap because the river of task rewards recycles deposits.
